document_review.summary: The v14 package reads as natural, professionally written Malaysian Bahasa Melayu tech-blog content throughout. Register is consistent (informal-professional tutorial tone), terminology for Canva/AI concepts is used consistently (foto, sunting/penyuntingan, latar belakang, pelarasan, penapis, ciri), and retained English terms (slider, vignette, plugin, font, prompt, Upload, Add from Canva) are appropriate interface/technical labels a Malaysian writer would naturally keep untranslated. Curly-quote interface labels rendered from HTML entities read naturally as reader-facing quotation marks. No bureaucratic or overly academic phrasing was found. Minor stylistic notes (elliptical subject-drop in colon-led bullet labels such as 'Ciri AI yang inovatif: Membantu...'; a few figcaptions omitting a trailing period while others include one) are consistent with common Malaysian listicle/caption conventions and would not be noticed as errors by a fluent reader, so they are not treated as failures.
document_review.notes: Whole-document pass. Rank Math title/description intentionally out of scope per transport-limitation note; not treated as missing body copy.
